issue_context.title: Warning 1356 is returned and result is empty by querying information_schema.columns when a scalar subquery is used as a column in view definition
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```
mysql> create table t1(id int);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.06 sec)

mysql> create view v1 as select (select id from t1) as col from dual;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.07 sec)

mysql> select column_name, table_name from information_schema.columns where table_name='v1';
Empty set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> show warnings;
+---------+------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Level   | Code | Message                                                                                                                   |
+---------+------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Warning | 1356 | View 'test.v1' references invalid table(s) or column(s) or function(s) or definer/invoker of view lack rights to use them |
+---------+------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

```
+-------------+------------+
| column_name | table_name |
+-------------+------------+
| col         | v1         |
+-------------+------------+
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

The warning 1356 is reported.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

v6.1.0 and above
comments: Possibly related to the use of sys session after https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/33946.

review_comments: please add some comment on why we must open an explicit txn
is this where the fix is, replace with another session ctx?

The original error is "ctx provider not found", but it's overwritten https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/54809. So the first fix is add `sessiontxn.NewTxn`.

Then another problem is the system session still uses the `is` captured by closure, which has conflict with user session. So moving it here.
